subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel introduce `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` with hostname fallback, or should instance identity wait for the canonical resource-identity seam in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071?
rationale: The safe collector-visible instance identity source is a product/API decision because it affects operator env contracts, privacy, and backend grouping behavior.

options.title: Use canonical identity seam
options.body: Reject the new env/fallback contract and implement `service.instance.id` through the standard OTel resource path or the approved resource-identity seam from the canonical issue.

options.title: Accept the new env contract
options.body: Adopt `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID`, but require docs, precedence rules, privacy expectations, and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Pause for identity design
options.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until the canonical issue settles the stable instance source and proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Use canonical identity seam
recommendation.body: Reject the new env/fallback contract and implement `service.instance.id` through the standard OTel resource path or the approved resource-identity seam from the canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: `bek91` owns the open canonical resource-identity issue and has adjacent diagnostics trace-correlation context.
